title: BetaManagedAgentsMcpOauthAuthResponse
description: OAuth credential details for an MCP server.

mcp_server_url.description: URL of the MCP server this credential authenticates against.

expires_at.description: When the credential's access token expires, in RFC 3339. Absent if the expiry isn't known.

refresh.description: Refresh token configuration, if the credential supports token refresh.
